title: ci: per-prompt metrics integration and CI hook for regression gating
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: add a CI-side per-prompt metrics integration so the eval harness can compute and upload per-prompt quality/latency metrics as part of PR checks. This enables per-prompt regression gating and richer dashboards for model rollouts. What this PR does: 1) new lightweight metrics uploader (eval_harness/ci/per_prompt_metrics.py) that computes per-prompt accuracy, latency_summary, token_counts and posts aggregated metrics to the internal metrics service (supports dry-run and auth via CI token). 2) GitHub Actions change: .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml added a new job `per-prompt-metrics` that runs a small sampled eval on changed prompt-sets and posts results as annotations and a metrics payload. 3) tests: tests/eval/test_metrics_integration.py adds unit and integration tests (mock metrics service). 4) docs: docs/ci_metrics.md documents how to add new prompt-sets to CI sampling and how gating thresholds work. 5) small infra: Dockerfile tweak and pyproject dependency bump for prometheus-client and requests. Backwards compatibility: uploader is opt-in via repo-level config eval-ci.yml -> metrics: enabled:true and defaults to dry-run in forks. Risk: some eval suites are long-running so job uses a sampling policy (sample_rate configurable) to keep CI time reasonable. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration tests (mocked) [x] docs updated [x] Linear ticket linked [x] canary rollout plan for enabling org-wide

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can we limit sampled prompt-sets to changed files only and add a size cap? Otherwise CI time balloons.
Aisha Patel: Good catch - implemented a changed-file filter and max-samples cap (configurable). Updated tests to assert filtering.
Lena Cho: Need clear failure semantics: a metrics regression should annotate the PR but not fail unless gating is enabled. Please add dry-run semantics and annotation behavior.
Aisha Patel: Added dry-run by default for forks and added `gating.enabled` config; CI will annotate and fail gate only when gating.enabled=true and run from main or trusted branches.
Owen Park: CI flaked once on the prometheus client download - retriggered and added a retry wrapper to the workflow. Approving after retries passed.

release_notes: Add optional per-prompt metrics CI job and uploader. Enables per-prompt regression annotations and opt-in gating; configurable sample rate and gating behavior.
merge_summary: Merged to main via squash. CI green after second run. Gate disabled by default; ops will enable gating gradually for core repos.
notes_for_ops: Enable gating via repo config eval-ci.yml.metrics.gating.enabled=true for repos after observing metrics stability for 2 weeks. Use sample_rate to limit CI time.

monitoring: dashboard updated to include per-prompt time series
